# EvaluLabs

> EvaluLabs (https://www.evalulabs.com) is an AI mock interview platform. You
> pick a company and role, an AI interviewer runs a full-length session using
> questions real candidates were actually asked there, and you get scored on
> communication, technical depth and problem solving with written feedback.

Not to be confused with Evalulab (evalulab.com), an unrelated clinical testing
company for cosmetics based in Montreal.

## What makes it different

- Questions are contributed by verified sources: people who work at the company
  or interviewed there recently, confirmed via company email or offer letter.
  Nothing in the bank is scraped or model-invented.
- The AI interviewer adopts each company's interviewing tone, so pacing and
  follow-up pressure match the real panel.
- Voice mode: answer out loud with real-time transcription.
- Scoring uses an anchored 0-10 rubric across communication, technical depth,
  problem solving and overall readiness. Vague or blank answers score low by
  design, so the score is trackable over time.
- A progress dashboard tracks readiness across companies and roles.

## Plans

- Free: a monthly allowance of AI mock interviews with scoring and feedback. No
  card required.
- Paid tiers: detailed insights, topic-level breakdowns, higher monthly limits.
- Top-up packs: extra interviews that roll over and do not expire on renewal.
- Institutional sponsorships: colleges and companies can grant a full plan to
  everyone on their email domain, with a per-cycle interview limit they set.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.evalulabs.com/): product overview and FAQ.
- [Companies](https://www.evalulabs.com/companies): browse companies and roles to practise against.
- [Skills](https://www.evalulabs.com/skills): practise by topic — system design, data structures, behavioural and more.
- [Pricing](https://www.evalulabs.com/pricing): plan tiers, limits and top-up packs.
- [About](https://www.evalulabs.com/about): how the interview loop and question sourcing work.
- [Enterprise](https://www.evalulabs.com/enterprise): college and company sponsorships.
- [Contact](https://www.evalulabs.com/contact): support and sponsorship enquiries.
